news.html: I co-founded BASAL Intelligence and serve as CEO.
I completed my PhD at Tsinghua University, advised by Prof. Xianyuan Zhan and Prof. Ya-Qin Zhang. My thesis focused on Data Flywheel for Intelligent Decision-Making.
New work: World Value Models and TTT-VLA — value modeling and test-time adaptation for robotic manipulation.
Demystifying Action Space Design is accepted to ICML 2026 and received the Best Paper Award at the Efficient Spatial Reasoning Workshop @ ICLR 2026.
